recommendation: Keep the source change. It fixes a current built history-page ambiguity without restoring retired implementation-guide pages or changing current IG publication policy.
issue_request: FHIR-5213 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking the January 2015 version 0.4 history entry to clarify that the listed implementation guides did not all share the same ballot status.
initial_application: The original #5213 application in git commit 84095b0c9051, imported from svn revision 4515, added a link from the 0.4 history entry to iglist.html's discussion of implementation-guide status.
additional_context: The linked iglist.html page later carried the relevant status table, but a 2016 broken-link cleanup replaced the history link with code-styled placeholder text and a 2017 rendering cleanup deleted iglist.html. The current source/hierarchy.xml still includes history.html as the built Version History page, so the placeholder was a lost clarification rather than an intentional reversal.
reconciliation: Changed source/history.html to make the 0.4 note self-contained: the guides were published with the release, but Argonaut content was not balloted, DAF and SDC had separate ballots, and the US Laboratory guides were part of the FHIR DSTU ballot.
source_changes: source/history.html: replaced the dead 'see discussion of status' placeholder in the 0.4 New Implementation Guides note with a self-contained ballot-status clarification.

related_jiras.note: The later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue added normativeness/status text to iglist.html, confirming the status discussion that FHIR-5213 had linked to.
